priority_policy: Prefer finishing near-complete work before opening a new front.
Otherwise choose the first ready tool in recompiled priority order, then recreated priority order.
near_complete_criteria: All required outputs for the candidate step already exist.
Remaining work is limited to evidence refresh, focused parity checks, or narrowly scoped fixes.
Remaining work fits in one material batch.
Finishing the candidate does not violate step start gates.

ready_when: Any required output under <tool>/recompiled/ is missing.
Parity evidence or closeout requirements are incomplete.
Step 1 outputs exist and <tool>/technical_specification.md is missing.
The spec exists but lacks traceability, evidence, or full feature inventory coverage.
The step 2 spec exists and any required output under <tool>/recreated/ is missing.
Three-way parity evidence or closeout requirements are incomplete.

resume_rules: Recompute state from files and docs rather than from memory.
If required outputs exist but closeout evidence is missing, stay in the same step.
Treat prior evidence as stale when it predates a material change to covered code, tests, fixtures, or requirement mapping.
Refresh stale evidence before marking closeout criteria as satisfied.
Use confirmed/open/blocked consistently across inventories and checklists.
Document blockers with parity impact and closure experiments in repo artifacts.
